patterns.note: Full-viewport height sections that dramatically replace each other on scroll, creating a distinct scene-by-scene progression rather than continuous scrolling.
Aggressively distressed or stencil-effect display typography for brand elements, contrasting with clean, bold, condensed sans-serifs for informational text.
A high-contrast palette dominated by black and white, punctuated by a vibrant, almost neon, lime green/yellow accent color for emphasis.
The initial video hero scrolls away to reveal subsequent full-screen content blocks, creating a dramatic, almost cinematic transition between sections.
Content is organized into distinct, often full-bleed, full-height visual modules that function as individual 'screens' or 'slides' within the page flow.

technique_notes: The site uses full-bleed video backgrounds in hero sections, often with distressed text overlays for a raw, experimental feel.
Content is presented in distinct, often full-viewport height sections that replace each other on scroll, creating a strong sense of progression or scene changes.
Typography is heavily stylized, using custom or highly modified fonts with a distressed or stencil effect for display elements, contrasting with clean, bold sans-serifs for functional text.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, distressed display headings (~5-8x body) with a raw, stencil character, complemented by bold, condensed sans-serifs for informational text.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, characterized by generous negative space around full-screen content blocks, creating a sense of drama and focus.

standout: The site's distinctive use of raw, aggressively distressed typography combined with full-bleed, high-contrast video and image sections creates an experimental and almost brutalist aesthetic. The dramatic, full-screen content transitions on scroll are also highly impactful, making each section feel like a new scene.
